controles.affirmation: Dette financiere nette de 2 722 M€ au 30 juin 2026 contre une tresorerie nette de 369 M€ fin 2025 ; ratio de fonds propres 28,0% contre 33,5%
controles.verbatim_source: the equity ratio as at 30 June 2026 amounted to 28.0% (31 December 2025: 33.5%). Net financial debt from continuing operations decreased to €-2,722 million at the end of the first half of the 2026 fiscal year (31 December 2025: €369 million)

controles.affirmation: Financement par club deal de 1 000 M€ et emission obligataire de 500 M€ (acquisition Naval Vessels Lurssen)
controles.verbatim_source: this change is primarily attributable to the raising of a syndicated loan (club deal) of €1,000 million (nominal value), the issue of a bond worth €500 million (nominal value), and the raising of short-term time deposits amounting to €550 million

controles.affirmation: Flux de tresorerie disponible operationnel de -1 616 M€ au S1 2026 contre -631 M€ au S1 2025 (-985 M€)
controles.verbatim_source: operating free cash flow fell significantly by €985 million to €-1,616 million (previous year: €-631 million), as the timing of advance payments shifted

controles.affirmation: Risque 'Production et execution des projets' releve de 'low' a 'medium', seule categorie degradee du tableau des risques
controles.verbatim_source: The steadily rising sales and production targets are a key driver for the increase in the risk assessment from a 'low' to a 'medium' risk. Tableau : 'Production and project implementation | Medium | Possible | Medium risk | Low risk (2024 adjusted)' ; toutes les autres lignes 'Unchanged'
controles.correction_proposee: La probabilite anterieure ('rare') n'est pas indiquee dans le tableau FY2025, qui ne donne que la probabilite 2025 ('Possible'). Retirer ou sourcer separement le passage 'de rare a possible'.

controles.affirmation: Consequences a moyen et long terme de l'arret du F126 non encore mesurees ; prevision de CA reduite de 300 M€ pour 2026 ; guidance groupe 13,7 a 14,2 Mds €
controles.verbatim_source: The medium- and long-term implications for the opportunities and risks of Rheinmetall resulting from the termination of the F126 frigate programme at the end of June 2026 are currently being analysed. / Sales forecasts for Naval Systems, and consequently for the Group as a whole, are being reduced by €300 million for the current fiscal year 2026. / €13.7 billion to €14.2 billion

controles.affirmation: Digital Systems : Rheinmetall Nomination 4 702 M€ au S1 2026, -52% (-5 042 M€) ; marge operationnelle de 5,3% a 7,7%
controles.verbatim_source: Rheinmetall Nomination amounted to €4,702 million, which is a significant decline of €5,042 million or 52% compared with the same period of the previous year ; The operating result margin therefore climbed to 7.7% (previous year: 5.3%)

controles.affirmation: 'Les quatre autres divisions (Vehicle Systems, Weapon and Ammunition, Air Defence, Naval Systems) affichent toutes une hausse de leurs prises de commandes sur la periode'
controles.verbatim_source: Naval Systems ... was included in reporting as a separate segment for the first time at the end of the first quarter of 2026. In the four months following the takeover at the end of February 2026, Rheinmetall Nomination recorded order intake of €1,004 million.
controles.correction_proposee: Naval Systems n'a pas de base de comparaison : segment consolide seulement depuis fin fevrier 2026. Ecrire 'les trois autres divisions comparables affichent une hausse, Naval Systems entrant au perimetre en cours de periode'.
